newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Direct Capital takes 24 pct of Gallagher.
newsitem.headline: Direct Capital takes 24 pct of Gallagher.

text.p: New Zealand's Direct Capital Partners on Wednesday said it had invested NZ$4.0 million in debt and equity in Gallagher Mailing Services for a 24 percent shareholding.
Direct Capital said its investment was linked to a convertible note which offered the ability to increase its shareholding to 34.2 percent.
Direct said Gallagher was involved in the information management industry and was expanding through New Zealand and Australia.

Gallagher was forecasting sales in the current year of $25 million and the growth of business through its two Sydney offices was expected to account for 40 percent of business in the next three years.
George said that Gallagher was purchased through a management buyout (MBO) late in 1994 and those key executives were the new shareholding partners of Direct Capital.
George said listed direct investment companies like Direct Capital were showing a trend globally towards MBO investments.
He said that in Britain over 50 percent of capital commitments from direct investment funds were channelled into companies led by management.

"We expect transactions of this type to grow in New Zealand," said George. "Overseas research shows that management buyout operations achieve superior risk-adjusted returns compared to other opportunities for development capital."
